clips.title: The story
paras: Stocking Jetsteam is an Alliance quest offered by Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. Preparing his siege engine for an extended deployment with the Ironforge Siege Brigade, the pilot enlists local hunters to gather boar meat and bear pelts to provision his crew.

Stationed just outside Kharanos at Steelgrill's Depot, Pilot Bellowfiz oversees preparations for an upcoming long-haul operation on behalf of the Siege Brigade. His siege tank, dubbed Jetsteam, requires both mechanical tuning from master engineer Beldin Steelgrill and a month's worth of field provisions to keep its crew functional in the harsh sub-zero temperatures of Dun Morogh.

Because Beldin Steelgrill is occupied under Jetsteam's hood, Bellowfiz cannot abandon his vehicle to gather rations and insulation. He directs travelers to hunt in the snowy plains south of the Grizzled Den, where indigenous boars provide hardy meat for food and native bears yield thick pelts suitable for warm tank bedding.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade. It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies. So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me?
I'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food. You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... You can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Preparations are going well. How goes your hunting?

clips.title: Completion
paras: By Magni's beard, you sure did a lot of hunting!! Thank you, friend.
